# Build your own robot vacuum, robot mop, or vacuum-mop combo

> DIY robot vacuum, robot mop and robot vacuum-mop combo: open-source hardware (MIT) with laser-cut and 3D-printed parts, ESP32 firmware, a coverage path planner, and a cleaning simulator you can try in your browser on your own room.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
